replies.author: NutMeggs
replies.body: I don't like the overall aesthetics of it. Besides the fact that the middle is the same hypixel map that a lot of the other maps have, it seems very disorganized, kind of like you decided what to put in your map and pieced it together but it never really fit together. I like the waterfall but thats about it. The diamond count is wayyyyyyy too much and I don't know what you mean by "hidden in secret locations" for the full iron... does this mean that only you and people with xray will know where this armor is? because I was breaking blocks all over the place and couldn't find any of the chests... Also the spawn and walls are copied which makes it even less unique. I don't think I really like this map I think if you added more overall flow to the map it would make it so much better. Also if you made your own walls and your own middle it would definitely be better. Sorry for the harsh critique I swear it was just a critique, sorry if I'm seeming mean.

replies.author: ClubberNugget
replies.body:
Ok i so i downloaded the map and here is what i think:
a. Technical thing, you didn't rotate all the quads correctly, as others have said.

b. the map itself doesnt really bring anything new to the table, the center is the generic center, the quads seem like a mixture of Grun Kaskade and Garden and there is nothing that really stands out.

c. There are a lot of diamonds down in the cave :P

d. Another technicality, i think you made this in 1.8, which messed up the chests and if you have any 1.8 blocks, they are going to disappear.

e. The Waterfall looks really chunky, it needs some work.

f. The chest palette is alright, nothing bad but nothing i'm crazy about.

Ultimately, i do not think this map is going to get accepted.  I don't like to sound mean so don't think i'm trying to hate on this map, just trying to point out what i see.  But on the bright side, making a map and finishing it is good practice for map making in the future, just presenting a finished product is good experience.  But anyway, good work and keep going at it!
